name: Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, musculocontractural type
description: Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, musculocontractural type is a congenital form of Ehlers-Danlos syndrome characterized by distinct craniofacial features, multiple contractures, progressive joint and skin laxity, adduction-flexion contractures of the thumbs, talipes equinovarus, bruisability and multisystem fragility-related manifestations.
